scene: A metallic weather dial ticks behind the fluttering wind socks.
picture: A flat side view along the breezy grass ridge. Far left, the wooden chairlift station sits quiet. Left, a tall pole carries striped wind socks, with a wooden ladder leaning beside it. The boy in his orange vest and scarf stands centre, studying the ticking bronze dial. Far right, the tea hut door stands open.
shown: a notched bronze dial mounted on the pole, centre, clicking softly
a short maintenance ladder leaning against the tall pole on the left
a wooden tea hut with its front door open on the far right
